programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are in a race against Captain Pak Choi to find buried treasure on Shiny Things Island, but they soon realise that it is one big trick by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Supertato S02
programme.desc: Evil Pea plans to break the Tatoscope by pretending she's hurt her foot and getting Supertato to invite her into Tato Tower to recover.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01
programme.desc: Get ready, set, dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team! Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Bluey S01
programme.desc: When Mum goes out to a baby shower, Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine. But with Bluey missing Mum, Dad has to pull out all the games he knows to keep them entertained.

programme.title: Bluey S02
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Bluey S02
programme.desc: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour, Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S02
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01
programme.sub-title: Andy and the Long Tailed Macaques
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer and head to Thailand on a global adventure in search of long-tailed macaques. The team discover macaques have an appetite for shellfish.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: 神刀
programme.desc: 神刀大侠临终时，把神刀传给了徒弟林振啸，而且更识破了另一徒弟方世雄为夺神刀而混入门下的奸计。方世雄为了神刀，令林家破人亡和双目失明。最后，林振啸与方世雄大战为家人报仇，并誓要重夺神刀…

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: 武松
programme.desc: 一次醉酒后，武松赤手空拳打死一只猛虎，因此被任命为都头。武松兄长武大郎的妻子潘金莲色诱武松，但遭他拒绝。后来，潘金莲和富户西门庆有染，及后奸情败露，两人继而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉后，先杀潘金莲再杀西门庆，为兄长报仇。

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集
programme.desc: 欧阳锋得悉郭靖以九阴真经的功夫于选婿比武中获胜，并娶得黄蓉为妻，于是把黄蓉挟走，要胁郭靖要默写九阴真经才会释放黄蓉。最终郭靖会否为救出黄蓉而就范？

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神
programme.desc: 军阀割据时代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的传统骗术层出不穷，「蛇神」、「李三脚」、「三只手」等一群妖言惑众的骗徒令人云亦云的愚民上钓，反映旧时代一切牛鬼蛇神众生相。

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: 南少林与北少林
programme.desc: 满清入主中原后，北少林为免遭剿灭，只好受命派出弟子到清军府担任教头，谁知抵达后，始知府中已有南少林教头；期间将军挑动两派人不和继而公开比武互相残杀，后南派因弟子伤亡而与北派交恶，展开一番互相残杀...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: 乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱
programme.desc: 孙玉郎与刘慧娘，裴政与徐雅本是两对情投意合的恋人，阴差阳错间，孙玉郎男扮女装代姐拜堂，刘慧娘则代兄娶妻。他们的婚约误配，让成误会，终闹上公堂，乔太守将错就错，干脆来了一个乱点，结果正好有情人终成眷属，皆大欢喜。

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: 六指琴魔
programme.desc: 女侠风灵得悉"六弦魔琴"重现江湖，唯一能克制魔琴的只有火弦弓及火羽箭，唯袖手樵隐知其下落；风找得群雄一起找樵；期间，众人发现逍遥隐士就是六指琴魔...

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: 愤怒青年
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉郁，与父亲缺乏沟通，被人利用，误入歧途。昌逃不过暴力的魔爪和色情的引诱，竟然出卖父亲，让父亲惨死。昌悲悔交加，独闯飞仔巢，逐一将之击毙，自已也进入疯狂状态。

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: 血洒天牢
programme.desc: 宋末，大元初把天下统一，元帅将宋丞相文天祥打入天牢，意图说服其归元，亦希望借机将往救文之抗元义士一网打尽。义士之一白鸭儿在拯救途上，遇着「金掌」乐何如，忙邀共同救国，但乐自认跟踪白为贪图美色，救国非少数人所能为，拒绝后旋即逸去。及后，一众义士为救文，纷纷藉故犯法，先后成功被关入天牢，白竟在天牢再遇乐...

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: 斗气小神仙
programme.desc: 丁安安与雍晴两个表姐妹自小就读于同一所女校，因二人的母亲一向口和心不和，从小就向自己女儿灌输好胜思想，因此形成安安与晴从小斗到大，三日一小吵，五日一大斗。她们在校中认识了男同学米高及保罗，很快成为情侣，两对小冤家后来因斗气竟然互调了男朋友…

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: 快活林
programme.desc: 武松杀死潘金莲及西门庆后，被判发配孟州牢营。武松元照例要接受一百下杀威棒，但得施恩求情，侥幸获得豁免。武松为报答施恩，当知道她的「快活林」酒家被「蒋门神」蒋忠夺去，誓要不惜一切助她取回酒家。

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: 黑鹰
programme.desc: 新加坡的黑鹰组织专与香港保险业作对。私家侦探张世杰从黑鹰领袖陈祖培女儿丽思入手。他俩认识后，不断受到狙击追杀，原来陈祖培于一年前已遭人杀害，胡媚用陈名义发号施令，为非作歹。张世杰与黑鹰集团展开连场激战！

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: 大海盗
programme.desc: 海盗张保仔洗劫一艘外国商船后，发现海盗船身出现裂痕。于是他上岸寻找材料修船，竟发现清朝贪官正在欺压贫苦农民。本性善良的张保仔，决心要锄强扶弱，最终更成为著名的大海盗。

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: 老夫子
programme.desc: 与老夫子一起经历连串的漫画故事，看他和他傻头傻脑的好友大番薯如何为抱得美人归而弄至笑话连篇！

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: 绝不低头
programme.desc: 少女波波为寻父和找寻未婚夫罗烈，遇上童时玩伴黑豹，黑豹是城中势力最大金二爷的助手。波波在黑豹照料下，逐渐忘记罗烈而爱上黑豹，黑豹自幼就喜欢波波，但是处处输给罗烈，心狠手辣的他，逼婚不成，便在波波面前折磨金二爷，原来金二爷竟是波波的父亲赵大爷，后来罗烈出狱…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: 白发鬼
programme.desc: 年轻俊秀，生于名门望族的日籍华人林保，自幼失去父母，与大学好友川村感情深厚。二人都对美少女琉璃子心存爱慕，但川村自怜身世，不敢与林保争夺，林保顺利娶得琉璃子为妻。林保出国公干期间，川村和琉璃子耐不住寂寞，有了奸情。不久之后，林保竟在一次滑雪中意外身亡...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，还重新找回了对生命的热情，并更加珍惜那些在生命中真正重要的人。

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: 南北妈打
programme.desc: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚。关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文。申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿。两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活。

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: 表错七日情
programme.desc: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿。丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇。那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情…

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的“天地会”被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落。韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态。

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: 雪儿
programme.desc: 舞蹈教师雪儿年轻貌美，被富商戴家乐力追，但她却喜欢青年艺术家阿化，并与他同居。戴家乐心有不甘，设计让雪儿对他改观，更利诱阿化离开雪儿！

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: 马永贞
programme.desc: 从山东逃难至上海的马永贞，因救了势力人士谭四而受到赏识，又从黑帮头子杨双手上夺取了他在上海的第一个地盘，从此平步青云。杨双与巡捕房勾结，谋害谭四并派人伏杀马永贞…

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: 撞邪先生
programme.desc: 美容院职员曾小雨机缘巧合之下，认识了富豪之子利志，以为交上好运。岂料利志的父亲是茅山高人，在南洋大败一降头师时，被下咒绝子绝孙，让利志每次恋爱皆遭恶鬼破坏，无疾而终。小雨深爱利志，找大法师沈慈航帮助，授以五色驱邪带，两人顺利结婚。新婚之夜，利志遗失了驱邪彩带，果然恶鬼来犯...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: 替身纸人
programme.desc: 警方在调查一宗团伙杀人案时，突然又发生了离奇的纸人杀人事件，嫌疑人一个接一个被杀。随着不断挖出的线索，警方最终发现这背后隐藏着横跨两代人的秘密与悲剧。

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: 一个人的武林
programme.desc: 武术教头夏侯武因错手杀人沦为阶下囚，却在狱中敏锐察觉到一场针对全港武林高手的连环杀戮。他凭神准预判命案成功赢得女督察陆玄心的信任，破格出狱协助调查。与此同时，先天残疾却武痴成狂的封于修四处血腥挑战各路宗师。随着杀戮疯狂升级，两位绝世武者终将迎来轰烈对决。

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: 叶问 2
programme.desc: 日本侵华后，咏春大师叶问与家人因生活艰难离开佛山，远赴香港开馆收徒，希望可以开展新生活。但事情并未如所想般容易，他欲在香港开武馆，就必须接受各大门派的挑战。一场又一场的功夫较量正式展开！

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: 孤僻尽责的警员王伟业在值班时误救重伤垂死的悍匪韩江，却不知对方正是血腥残暴的「鬼王党」首领。韩江伤愈后率部再掀连环血案，让极度自责的王伟业瞬间陷入疯狂心魔，在扭曲的正义与精神崩溃的边缘痛苦徘徊。为了弥补致命过错，他决定彻底释放心中的恶魔，以魔制魔。

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey

programme.title: 情逆三世缘
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌(欧阳震华)错手杀害女友杨夕雪(关咏荷)。在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯(欧阳震华)身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜(关咏荷)出现眼前。包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安(黄智贤)陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙(欧阳震华)探长。在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤(关咏荷)却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人。龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排。悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤。金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者......

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波......当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面......

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘......

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌(欧阳震华)错手杀害女友杨夕雪(关咏荷)。在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯(欧阳震华)身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜(关咏荷)出现眼前。包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安(黄智贤)陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙(欧阳震华)探长。在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤(关咏荷)却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人。龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排。悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤。金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者......

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波......当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面......

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘......

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎(钱嘉乐)受不了母亲刘并蒂(黄淑仪)不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾(陈键锋)抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英(胡定欣)的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘(苏玉华)制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波......当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为【王老虎抢亲】谱出崭新局面......

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: 金宵大厦
programme.desc: 萧伟明(陈山聪饰)来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex (李施桦饰)容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联。其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO(李施桦分饰)，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉(陈山聪分饰)，奇梦还被书店主人林若思(张彦博饰)写成小说。阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘......

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。 失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……
